response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM per) SELECT per.driverId, per.avg_points, per.avg_wins, per.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS diff_from_mean FROM per CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (per.avg_wins - m.mean_wins) IS NULL, (per.avg_wins - m.mean_wins) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the unweighted mean of per-driver average wins, over drivers having at least one standings row with points > 1.0. Drivers with no such rows are excluded from both the output and the mean.
'Proceed only if that mean exists' is implemented as a filter that returns no rows when the mean is NULL.
Ties in the difference have no specified order, so the order among tied drivers is arbitrary.
